[[House of Thul|House Thul]] maintained a '''droid factory''' in [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The factory was captured by [[House Ulgo]], but ultimately returned to Thul control.
